name: Being Organized
overview: Scripture reveals that being organized reflects God's own nature as Creator, who brought order from chaos at the beginning (Genesis 1:1). The believer's life is to be carefully ordered by the Lord, delighting Him as our steps are established (Psalms 37:23). Practical diligence is encouraged, such as attentively managing what God has entrusted to us (Proverbs 27:23), while clarity and intentionality in our vision and plans enable effective pursuit of God's purposes (Habakkuk 2:2). Ultimately, this pursuit of order and excellence aligns with the call to be perfect as our heavenly Father is perfect (Matthew 5:48).
